items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: Bessie Smith, who died before the concert obviously.

ctx.x: It’s from the original — from the box set, yeah.

Well ‘cause I found the original program in the New York Public Library. And it was all yellowed and I had a dust-up with our art director. Because if you notice in the set, it’s got the Bessie Smith picture and it’s the original program, but I had to format it to fit in © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

the — because you know it’s this wide instead of this wide to fit in a box set. But it was all yellowed and I loved it. And I made copies in the New York Public Library. But the art director at Welk in Santa Monica got into it. Because when the artwork came back for my first approval she had taken all the yellow out of it and it was white. And I said no, no, no, no, no. I said, “That was part of the charm is the yellowed paper from all those decades.” And we got into it about it. And Larry Welk backed me and I…
